name: S.S. Tidal
lines:
(Oh. It’s a local kid...)
H-hullo. Me from Unova region.
Me no talk pretty. You understand?

Whoa! You understand me talk!
Me so happy! So relief!
Very, very happy feeling, so I give.
I give this! You take!

It a Sharp Beak!
You give to Flying-type Pokémon!
I wish I sharp like beak. Then I learn
this regional’s language quick.
I not so sharp self, but learning new
language really fun, yes?

I wish me talk better someday...
But I not so sharp self. Still long way go!
